title: ICMP echo is not proxied and never answered with a fake reply.
requirement: M1 task 3 ICMP behaviour; diagnostics must not mislead users.

checks.detail:
PING 10.30.0.2 (10.30.0.2) 56(84) bytes of data.

--- 10.30.0.2 ping statistics ---
3 packets transmitted, 0 received, 100% packet loss, time 2026ms

checks.check: raw echo requests injected at the TUN (IPv4, IPv6, IPv6 behind an extension header) get no reply
engine sent zero ICMP echo replies
engine dropped the echo requests before its stack (and blocked any reply)
uplink: nothing left the device except to the proxy endpoint(s) [('10.20.0.2', 1080)]
uplink: no packet from the device reached a destination address directly
uplink: no DNS (port 53) left the device

notes: Kernel IPv6 ping skipped: kernel booted with ipv6.disable=1: kernel-level IPv6 cannot be exercised on this host; engine IPv6 is covered by hermetic Go tests (engine/engine_test.go TestIPv6*) — raw IPv6 echo requests are injected at the TUN instead
